analytical_checks.derivation: Marginal cost of adding i to T is sum of weights in R_i outside union R_j for j in T, decreasing with T. Marginal independent-success value is p_i times product(1-p_j), also decreasing. Thus fixed toy fits SCSK; no analogous physical assumption established. A deterministic selector is a function of arrays/state/ties: identical inputs and function imply identical output.
